questions.question: Find the value of { {( {216} )⁽²⁾/⁽³⁾} + {( {36} )⁽¹⁾/⁽²⁾}}
questions.solution:
Given,

⇒ 216⁽²/³⁾ + 36⁽¹/²⁾ = (6³)⁽²/³⁾ + (6²)⁽¹/²⁾

By using the law, (am)ⁿ = a⁽m × ⁿ⁾ we get,

∴ (6³)⁽²/³⁾ + (6²)⁽¹/²⁾ = 6{³ × ⁽²/³⁾} + 6{² × ⁽¹/²⁾} = 6² + 6 = 36 + 6 = 42

questions.question: If p = sqrt {72 - sqrt {72 - sqrt {72 - sqrt {72 - ldots infty } } } } , then find the value of 2p² + 1.
questions.solution:
p = sqrt {72 - sqrt {72 - sqrt {72 - sqrt {72 - ldots infty } } } } 

Rightarrow p = sqrt {72 - p}

Squaring both sides we get,

⇒ p² = 72 – p

⇒ p² + p – 72 = 0

⇒ p² – 8p + 9p – 72 = 0

⇒ p(p – 8) + 9(p – 8) = 0

⇒ (p – 8)(p + 9) = 0

⇒ p = 8 (∵ p cannot be negative)

Now,

∴ the value of 2p² + 1 = 2(8)² + 1 = 129

questions.question:
In the given triangle ABC, a line is drawn from C which bisects AB at point D. Find the ratio of the area of triangles DBC and ABC.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bf219e528a4fd7c857cbadaf6dd776d58f9668e49e5d139f85e0612c9b3c4b34.png]
questions.solution:
**Calculation:**

As (6, 8, 10) is a pythagorean triplet so triangle ABC is a right angled triangle, right angled at B

Area of triangle ABC = (1/2) × base × height = 1/2 × 6 × 8 = 24 cm²

Now, point D bisects AB.

⇒ DB = (1/2) × AB = 1/2 × 8 = 4 cm

Also, triangle DBC is a right angle triangle, right angle at B Area of triangle DBC = (1/2) × base × height = 1/2 × 6 × 4 = 12 cm²

**∴ Required ratio = area of triangle DBC ∶ area of triangle ABC = 12 ∶ 24 = 1 ∶ 2**

questions.question: The area of a right angled triangle ABC, right angled at B, is 46 sq units. A median is drawn from A to BC which intersects at D. Find the area (in sq. units) of triangle ABD.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Area of triangle ABC = 46 unit² and AD is median

**Concept used:**

The media divides the triangle into two triangles of equal area

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/44f47bb30f01c7a78f250cb28fcbda7d5a914f5cb9294a80ea923ea328c56753.png] 

Area of triangle ABD = 1/2 × area of triangle ABC = 1/2 × 46 = 23 unit²

**∴ The correct answer is 23 unit2**

questions.question: X and Y give an exam. Difference of their marks is 45 and the difference of their marks is 15% of the maximum marks. What is the maximum marks for the exam?
questions.solution:
**Calculation:**

Let the maximum marks be a

Difference in marks = 45

According to the question,

Difference in marks = 15% of maximum marks

⇒ 45 = 15% of a

⇒ 45 = 15a/100

**∴ a = 300**

questions.question: If P : Q : R = 6 : 7 : 8 and R : S = 3 : 5, then what is P : S?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

P ∶ Q ∶ R = 6 ∶ 7 ∶ 8, and R ∶ S = 3 ∶ 5

**Calculation:**

We have to equal unit of R in both the ratio 

P ∶ Q ∶ R = 6 ∶ 7 ∶ 8 [ multiply by 3, we get ] 

P ∶ Q ∶ R = 18 ∶ 21 ∶ 24

Similarly R ∶ S = 3 ∶ 5 [ multiply by 8 we get ]

R : S = 24 : 40

Now,

⇒ P ∶ Q ∶ R ∶ S = 18 ∶ 21 ∶ 24 ∶ 40

**∴ P ∶ S = 18 ∶ 40 = 9 ∶ 20**

questions.question: In what ratio must a mixture of 11% sugar strength be mixed with that of 25% sugar strength so as to get a new mixture of 13% sugar strength?
questions.solution:
**Calculation:**

Let the ratio of mixing be a ∶ b

According to the question,

11% of a + 25% of b = 13% of (a + b)

⇒ 11a + 25b = 13a + 13b

⇒ 12b = 2a

⇒ a/b = 12/2 = 6/1

**∴ Required ratio = 6 ∶ 1**

Now,

questions.question: A sum of money invested at simple interest becomes 13/10 of itself in 2 years and 6 months. What is the rate (in percentage) of interest per annum?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Time of investment = 2 years 6 months = 2.5 years

**Concept used:**

Simple interest = (Principle × time × rate)/100 = (a × 2.5 × r)/100 = ar/40 

Here, Principal = a and rate = r

**Calculation:**

According to the question,

Amount = (13/10) × Sum of money invested

⇒ (a.r/40) + a = (13/10) × a

⇒ (r + 40)/40 = 13/10

⇒ r + 40 = 52

**∴ r = 12%**

questions.question: The ratio of the cost price and selling price of an article is 5 : 3. What is the loss percentage?
questions.solution:
**GIVEN:**

Ratio of CP : SP = 5 : 3

**FORMULA USED:**

Loss % = (Loss/CP) × 100 

**CALCULATION:**

Let the cost price be 5x and selling price be 3x

⇒ Loss = 5x – 3x = 2x

∴ Loss percentage = (Loss/Cost price) × 100 = (2x/5x) × 100 = 40%

questions.question:
A shopkeeper offers the following 3 schemes. Which scheme has the maximum discount percentage?

I. Two successive discounts of 30% and 20%

II. Buy 4 get 7

III. Buy 4 get 3 free
questions.solution:
I. Two successive discounts of 30% and 20%

For successive discount of a% and b%,

Total discount = a + b – (ab/100)

Now, Total discount = 30 + 20 – {(30 × 20)/100} = 50 – 6 = 44%

II. Buy 4 get 7

Let marked price of one item be Rs. 100

⇒ Marked price of 7 items = Rs. 700

⇒ Amount actually paid = Marked price of 4 item = Rs. 400

⇒ Discount = Rs. (700 – 400) = Rs. 300

⇒ Discount % = (Discount/Total marked price) × 100 = (300/700) × 100 = 42.85%

III. Buy 4 get 3 free

Buy 4 get 3 free is another way of saying buy 4 get 7

So,

⇒ Discount % = 42.85%

∴ Maximum profit is gained by scheme I

questions.question: 12 men or 30 boys can complete a work in 72 days. How many days will 48 men and 24 boys will take to complete the same work?
questions.solution:
**Calculation:**

Efficiency of 12 men = Efficiency of 30 boys

⇒ Efficiency of 2 men = Efficiency of 5 boys

⇒ Efficiency of 48 men = Efficiency of 120 boys

Now, we have of find out time taken by 48 men and 24 boys to complete the work or 144(120 + 24) boys to complete the works

Now,

Total work = time taken × number of workers = 72 × 30 = 2160

⇒ Time taken by 144 boys to complete the work = Total work/no. of workers = 2160/144 = 15 days

**∴ 48 men and 24 boys take 15 days to complete the work**

questions.question: A train starts moving from a place P at 10:00 a.m. and arrives at another place Q at 5:30 p.m. on the same day. If the speed of the train is 50 km/hr, then what will be the distance (in km) covered by the train?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Time taken by train = from 10:00 am to 5:30pm = 7hr 30 min = 7.5 hrs

Speed of train = 50 km/hr

**Concept used:**

Distance = speed × time

**Calculation:**

Distance covered by train = 50 × 7.5 = 375 km

**∴ The correct answer is 375 km**

questions.question: The area of a square is 42.25 cm². Find its perimeter (in cm).
questions.solution:
**Concept used:**

Area of square = a², and Perimeter of square = 4 × a, where side of square be a cm

**Calculation:**

According to the question

⇒ 42.25 = a²

⇒ a = 6.5

Now,

**∴ Perimeter = 4a = 4 × 6.5 = 26 cm**

questions.question: If the perimeter of a semicircle is 72 cm, then find its area (in cm²).
questions.solution:
**Concept used:**

Perimeter of semicircle = πr + 2r, where r = radius

**Calculation:**

According to the question,

⇒ 72 = (π + 2)r

⇒ 72 = {(22/7) + 2}r

⇒ 72 = (36/7)r

⇒ r = 14 cm

Now,

**∴ Area = 1/2 × π × r² = 1/2 × (22/7) × (14)² = 308 cm²**

questions.question: The volume of a cube is 274.625 cm³. Find its side (in cm).

a³ = 274.625

questions.question: ΔXYZ is right angled at Y. If ∠X = 45°, then find the value of (cosec Z + √3/2).
questions.solution:
**Given:**

∠Y = 90° and ∠X = 45°

**Concept used:**

• Sum of three angles of a triangle is 180° 

• cosec 45° = √2

**Calculation:**

By angle sum property of triangle

⇒ ∠Z = 180° – (∠X + ∠Y) = 180° – (90° + 45°) = 45°

Now,

cosec Z + (√3/2)

⇒ cosec 45° + (√3/2) 

⇒ √2 + (√3/2)

⇒ (2√2 + √3)/2

**∴ The correct answer is (2√2 + √3)/2**

questions.question: ΔXYZ is right angled at Y. If sin X = 4/5, then what is the value of cos Z?
questions.solution:
Sin X = 4/5

Sin X = perpendicular/hypotenuse = 4/5

So, Perpendicular = 4k and Hypotenuse = 5k

Now, if we are taking angle Z

base = perpendicular for angle X = 4k

Hypotenuse = 5k

∴ Cos Z = 4k/5k = 4/5
